name: Windows Defender Compatibility
changes: NewzDeckYenc.exe is built from the unchanged public NewzDeckYenc.go source with the standard Go build ID and symbol/debug metadata retained instead of the previous -s -w -buildid= stripping profile.
The Defender-compatible build override applies only to NewzDeckYenc.exe; the other five NewzDeck-owned Windows binaries retain the established stripped canonical build profile.

The isolated yEnc compatibility build, a full v3.6.74 Portable package containing only that helper/build-manifest adjustment, and a final exact-production-source yEnc build all passed Windows Defender acceptance testing before this release scope was authorized.

Newsgroup browsing behavior and telemetry schema 11, thumbnail scheduling/concurrency, provider allocation, Video sampling, All Posts resolver timing, Settings reliability, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, terminal history schema 3, Smart Import, Automation, Discover and Metadata Server v0.3.3 are unchanged.
regression_guards: NewzDeckYenc.go must remain at the exact v3.6.74 Git blob identity unless a future release intentionally changes decoder behavior.
release/windows/build-portable.py must use -H windowsgui for NewzDeckYenc.exe while retaining -s -w -H windowsgui -buildid= for every other NewzDeck-owned Go helper.
The canonical release workflow must run the v3.6.75 regression guard and verify that the generated NewzDeckYenc.exe retains a symbol table plus the SOURCE_MANIFEST Defender-compatibility override.
All established v3.6.74 browsing, Settings, download, Automation, Smart Import, Discover, SABnzbd 5.1.2 and terminal-history protections remain carried forward.
